title: RE-PIN check on native4b (agent slot, hidden desktop OK, NOT timing): Agent 4 task #12, REPIN.md section 3(b). n0old on native4, then n0/n2/n3 on build/agent2/native4b-bin (S4b + S4c)
notes: Written 2026-11-22 ~20:15 (Agent 4, task #12) from the 14:40 draft (superseded/matrix-repin-native5.json): native5 -> native4b-bin. Run it after REPIN.md step 3 (the pin record: built = MANIFEST = 9b40acbbef4c57b3), in Agent 3's S4b queue: bench\agent8\run\run-matrix.ps1 -Matrix build\agent4\repin\matrix-repin-native4b.json -NoPrompt -OutDir build\agent3\runs\repin-<stamp> (always pass -OutDir: without it the output goes to build\agent8\matrix and trips Agent 1's HOLD). 4 runs, about 15 min. Functional only (hidden desktop OK).

native4b-bin is Agent 2's S4b + S4c native build on the S3d line (build dir snap1-on), every switch OFF: C1 v3, M1, P2c, r1r2, #26 (tool OFF), #24 + #30 (OFF). Expected fingerprint 9b40acbbef4c57b3; the before (n0old, native4-bin) is 5e3ff55de10f4f64. Until native4b-bin has a MANIFEST.txt, run-matrix skips its arms.

Same settings as bench/agent4/s3/matrix-native3d-functional.json (S3's N1-N3): native_settings_frontend=false, uncapped, drivers/thread-cpu.ps1, a 30 s warm-up from the first frame (run-matrix's default min_window_after_ff_s of 60 makes it 60 s), then a 60 s window. n0old and n0 differ only in the bin. The boot check needs frontend on, so it is not on these arms: it has its own 1-run matrix, matrix-repin-native4b-boot.json (REPIN.md 3a).

Pass (REPIN.md 3b): python build\agent10\bgate\logdiff.py --base <n0old> --cand <n0>: NEW 0 and MORE 0 apart from the 'Native GPU [<fp>]' line (and, if n0old has 'slow frame' lines, P2c's new '| memexport full-buffer Nx (total N)' suffix on n0's). No S4b family line at defaults on any arm (no 'C1 keep-watch', 'd3d12_submit_split', 'deferred_counters' or 'GPU wait back-off' line). Draws per frame p10/p50/p90 on n0 the same as n0old, no new warning type, and a clean WM_CLOSE in all 4 runs. python bench\agent4\check_n_rows.py --baseline <n0> --rows n2=<dir> n3=<dir> exits 0. n0/n2/n3 then replace native3d's 0452-n0-r1/0454-n2-r1/0456-n3-r1 (build/agent8/matrix/20261122-0452/runs) as the n-row baseline.
On a fail, send the run dirs to Agent 4 and Agent 2; the pin stays on native4 (5e3ff55de10f4f64) and native4b-bin is parked.
